answer_1.quote: We demonstrate the effectiveness of CTVAE to generate controlled text by fine tuning two different attributes namely sentiment and formality.
answer_1.outputs: generated sentences with prescribed sentiment or formality levels

answer_2.quote: We report controlled generation accuracy, i.e., percentage of generated sentences from prior bearing target attribute and style inversion accuracy, i.e., the percentage of generated sentences from posterior bearing target attribute and related content. We also report attribute polarity score (AP) and relatedness score (R) ... R is Jaccard overlap of unigrams; AP is obtained from a pre‑trained sentiment regressor.

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation via crowdflower platform. Given a test sentence, we generate n sentences ... ask three annotators to rank these sentences from 1 to n and provide an absolute score for relatedness (R) of the generated sentences on a scale of 1 to 10.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank generated sentences by attribute control grade and rate relatedness to the original sentence; they also assess meaning preservation, degree of target attribute transfer, and naturalness.
